description: BackLog main window capabilities. Exactly what src/main.ts calls, and nothing implied twice: core:default already contains core:event:default and core:window:default, and dialog:default would additionally grant message/ask/confirm/save when the frontend only ever calls open(). updater:default plus process:allow-restart are what the signed self-update flow needs; they are contained by minisign verification but are the widest grant here, so SECURITY.md must name them.
